Accurate Puerta del León exterior, Real Alcázar Seville: modest RED-OCHRE plastered rectangular wall between two rough sandstone square crenellated towers, left tower broader. ONE modest round-arched CLOSED dark green wooden gate centrally below a small rectangular old lion tile panel. Pyramidal pointed caps on each square crenellation. A tiny projecting stone bracket above the lion panel. No clock, no dome, no minaret, no huge horseshoe gateway, no ornate fantasy palace. Long tan defensive wall recedes along left; a restrained narrow ochre residential facade and potted orange trees at far right. Dark dry stone-paved Plaza del Triunfo foreground. Keep both main towers including all crenellations and whole door centered inside central40% width, with sky headroom and ample plaza foreground; wider surroundings on either side. Eye-level distant frontal slightly oblique view facing southeast. Low warm ambient plaza light across rough masonry, substantial shadow; no theatrical floodlight beams or implausibly daytime-bright stone. Lighting is a modest artistic interpretation, not a claimed tonight observation.
